Subject: Renewal coordination: term & capacity uplift + QBR logistics

Hi Samir —

Following our usage spike last quarter, we want to get the renewal conversation started so we can lock in capacity and timelines that match Acero's growth plans. Proposed items for this thread:

- Confirm target term (12 vs 24 months) and any pricing preference.
- Lock expected capacity uplift (tokens / reserved GPU pools) and take rate timeline.
- Schedule a short QBR to review performance, cost optimization, and rollout plan.
- Identify decision-makers and procurement steps.

Quick asks to move this forward:
1) Can you confirm who from Acero should be at the QBR (product, security, procurement)?
2) Rough uplift estimate (percent or units) you expect at renewal.
3) Any hard deadlines on contract execution or procurement windows?

QBR windows we have available: Mar 22 (10–11am PT), Mar 23 (9–11am PT), or Mar 24 (1–2pm PT). If none work, share preferred slots and we'll adapt.

I attached a draft SOW and a QBR agenda template to help frame the discussion. Marissa — looping you for pricing/terms; Rishi — can you start looking at a capacity plan based on an initial +40% uplift scenario?

Thanks — happy to run the QBR and keep it tight (30–45 minutes) if that helps schedule.

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Account Manager | Redwood Inference

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear framing. Quick responses to your asks below and a few items from our side.

- Attendees: Myself (Head of AI), Lena Ortiz (Procurement), and Diego Ramos (Security lead) — I copied Lena here and will loop Diego on the calendar invite.
- Uplift: we're modeling a 35–45% reserved capacity increase over the next 12 months; we'll be more specific after the internal budget sync next week.
- Term preference: procurement prefers a 12-month renewal today but is open to a 24-month option if there's a compelling discount and flexible rollback terms.
- Deadline: procurement needs signed docs by end of April to hit budget cycles.

Preferred QBR: Mar 23, 10:00–11:00 PT would work for us. Can your team include someone from infra to speak to autoscale/burst options? Also send any pricing scenarios for 12 vs 24-month terms ahead of the meeting.

I'll attach a short list of renewal questions from procurement — mostly around data retention, audit logs, and SSO/SCIM timelines.

Cheers,
